crabcraft SQLite workload, C edition: proves the "any language, our ABI"
contract (Rust and Go exist; this is the C lane) and disk persistence --
the host mounts the workload's volume as its WASI cwd, so the database
file `crab.db` survives reboots and travels with the volume.
